concept: Kinesis Data Streams: real-time ingestion, multiple consumers and replay
tests: Choosing a service for a clickstream with multiple independent consumers and the ability to re-read data.
expected: Kinesis Data Streams — high-volume real-time, multiple independent consumers, records retained for replay within the retention period. Triggers: "real-time", "clickstream", "multiple independent consumers", "replay".
why_not: SQS deletes messages after processing, point-to-point; SNS — pub/sub with no retention for replay; Glue — ETL, not real-time ingestion.
